name: Deborah Davis
reason: Health rule still holds: her Shift courses are framed around bones and joints, her book Women's Qigong for Health and Longevity is sold on routines for insomnia, hypertension, menopause, breast health and cancer and osteoporosis (publisher description), and Kripalu describes her as an acupuncturist and medical intuitive; her old domain timelessbodyqigong.com only redirected to a Shift page. Almost nothing would pass the health-claim rule (re-checked 4 Nov 2026).
